entities.summary: Fr Andrzej Halemba – a Polish Catholic Presbyter, Fidei Donum missionary priest, translator of the New Testament and author of Mambwe-English dictionary, former Director of the Missionary Formation Centre in Warsaw and Secretary the Polish Episcopate Commission for Missions; Polish Bishops’ Conference Delegate for Missionary Affairs; founder of the Missionary Museum in Brzęczkowice, Poland. From 2006 to 2020 he worked for the international organisation “Aid to the Church in Need International”, located in Germany.
